Oman
Consular help:Consular help will be provided by the Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Ryadh, Saudi Arabia.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens (Visa shell be issued in Vienna or at time of entry):
Regular passport YES
Regular biometric passport YES
Service/Official biometric passport YES
Diplomatic biometric passport YES
Citizens of the Sultanate of Oman need a visa when entering, leaving or crossing the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina. The visa is issued at the Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Riyadh.
NOTE:In accordance with the Decision of the Council of Ministers of Bosnia and Herzegovina dated April 15, 2026, amending the Decision on Visas, citizens of the Sultanate of Oman holding ordinary passports are exempt from the obligation to obtain a visa for entry, exit, transit, and stay in the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina for the period from June 1, 2026 to September 30, 2026.
The total duration of stay for citizens of the Sultanate of Oman in Bosnia and Herzegovina within the specified period may be up to 60 days.
The stay of citizens of the Sultanate of Oman in Bosnia and Herzegovina under the aforementioned visa-free regime is permitted until September 30, 2026. For stays in Bosnia and Herzegovina after September 30, 2026, a visa is required.
